one_line: Name one buyer and occasion in the first line with the book in hand; end on the dedication page.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down: hands lift a book out of its MeBook box. Headline at the top, built word by word, the spoken word in magenta: "מחפשת מתנה ליום הולדת שנה?". The voice says the same (transcript). Cut outdoors at 0:03.
q1_hook.why: It names one buyer and one occasion in the first line (H1, K7), with the product handled from 0:00 (S1), and the question is said and written together (H6, T3). The first line of the headline sits near the top 14% edge (T4).

beats.what: Hands lift the book from its box on a linen cloth; "מחפשת מתנה ליום הולדת שנה?"
beats.why: Buyer, occasion and product in one frame

beats.what: Cover held up against trees and an evening sky; "ומיוחדת ולא עוד צעצוע?", "תכירי את ME BOOK"
beats.why: A clean, premium view of the cover; the brand named once

beats.what: Top-down: a baby in a chair holds the book up; "ספר בהתאמה אישית עם"
beats.why: A real child with the book

beats.what: A text page and a birthday spread held up; "הפנים והשם של הבייבי שלך", "הילד הוא הגיבור"
beats.why: Pages show print quality while the idea is said

beats.what: Baby touches the open book; a man reads to a baby on a couch; "כריכה קשה ואיכותית"
beats.why: A shared reading moment at home

beats.what: Outdoors: a spread of dancing sheep; "ולא רק זה"
beats.why: "And not only that" restarts the line

beats.what: Baby turns pages; the dedication page held to a sunset; "יש באתר עוד המון אופציות"
beats.why: A soft pointer over an emotional last image

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption's "תכירי את מי בוק!" is an introduction, not a request; no question, tip or send prompt.
q2_flow.why: A new picture every 2 to 3 s and a mid-way "ולא רק זה" keep it moving (R3, F8). The dedication page with the child's name is the closing image, an emotional last beat (R4, K1). The voice reads sales copy, with no feeling or story between the pictures (K4).

q3_cta.what: Written and said at 0:23 to 0:26: "יש באתר עוד המון אופציות של סיפורים ששווה להכיר". No code, link or ask. Caption: "תכירי את מי בוק!", an introduction.
q3_cta.why: A soft pointer after the benefits, in the top third, inside the safe zone (C6). But it asks for nothing: no site name, code or step, so an interested viewer has no action (C1).

q4_shown.what: The book lifted from its box; the cover held against a landscape; a baby with the book, seen from above; a text page and a birthday spread; a man reading to a baby; the dedication page with the child's name. No price.
q4_shown.why: The book is handled from 0:00 (S1), and the dedication page with the child's name is held for about 3 s (S2). But no photo sits beside the illustration, and the baby is seen only from above or behind (S2, S5). No customer voice vouches for it (S6).

q5_edit.what: 10 shots in 27 s, about 2.7 s each. Hard cuts, no speed changes seen. The headline builds word by word, the spoken word in magenta. Outdoor hand-held book shots alternate with indoor baby shots. Ends on the dedication page.
q5_edit.why: A cut at 3 s and a shot every 2 to 3 s keep a moderate pace (E1, E2). Word highlights track the voice (E4). It ends on the last line, with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A first-birthday gift idea: a book with the baby's face and name. It serves a parent or relative shopping for a one-year-old.
q6_topic.why: A named occasion and buyer make it a buying moment (K7), and a gift idea is easy to send on (R5). The facts, hard cover and many stories, come with no feeling or story (K4), so the mood stays calm (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld top-down shots of the unboxing and of a baby in a chair; a hand holds the cover and pages up against trees and an evening sky; a wide high shot of a man reading to a baby. Window and golden-hour light.
q7_filmed.why: A hand holding the book up to the viewer needs no face (S4, F5). Pages fill the frame and the text is readable (F4). Natural light and a real home read as native (H8, F7).

q8_text.on_screen: White text, 1 to 2 lines, the spoken word turning magenta, about 10 to 20% down: "מחפשת מתנה ליום הולדת שנה?" (0:00), "ומיוחדת ולא עוד צעצוע?" (0:03), "תכירי את ME BOOK" (0:05), "הפנים והשם של הבייבי שלך" (0:08), "כזה שמושך גם את הקטנטנים עם כריכה קשה ואיכותית" (0:18), "יש באתר עוד המון אופציות של סיפורים ששווה להכיר" (0:23).
q8_text.caption: "מחפשת מתנה מיוחדת ליום הולדת שנה? תכירי את מי בוק!" with two emojis. Two short lines plus 4 hashtags: line 2 is "@mebook.ai בשיתוף"; three tags are mother-identity words, one has the child's name, and one is #mebook. No CTA.
q8_text.why: Large word-by-word text carries the whole voice, so it works muted (T1), with a one-idea headline in the first second (T3). But full sentences stay up over the product (T2). The caption's first line has gift and occasion words and repeats the hook (T7), and the partnership word is on line 2 (T8, S7).

weak_points: A voice that reads ad copy; no first-person line; no real photo beside the page; no code, link or action at the end; a headline starting near the top 14% edge; the child's name in a hashtag.
lumebook_takeaway: Unbox top-down at a window, hold the cover and pages up to a view, add word-by-word headlines, end on the dedication page with one real CTA.
not_verified: Whether music plays; who the man and the baby are; whether the cover character matches the baby, who is seen only from above or behind. The transcript mishears words, so burned-in text is quoted. Likes are hidden by the creator. The child's name is on the dedication page, a story page and a hashtag, not quoted. The coded file agrees with the frames.
